timeline.title: YES Bank slides again after SC AT1 verdict
timeline.line: Supreme Court upheld quashing of the ₹8,415 cr AT1 write-off; stock down ~3% early
more: Shares closed 14.52% lower at ₹18.12 on Thursday after the ruling
The bank may have to pay bondholders ₹8,415 cr plus interest
Market value fell by about ₹9,605 cr on Thursday

timeline.title: Brokerages flag Yes Bank capital risk
timeline.line: Citi sees a 250 bp hit to CET1 from the AT1 ruling; results are due Saturday
more: Citi: CET1 could fall to 11.5%; book value down 13–14%
Morgan Stanley keeps underweight with a ₹17 target
Board meets Oct 17 to consider results

timeline.title: Yes Bank: ₹5,217 cr pro-forma loss on AT1
timeline.line: Reported profit rose 65% to ₹1,080 cr, but booking the AT1 ruling would mean a loss
more: The AT1 impact is not in reported results; auditors qualified their review
Net worth would fall to ₹46,970 cr from ₹53,268 cr
